opening: I've had a cough for years.
I've been coughing up blood recently.
I've been sweating, especially at night.
I've lost 6 pounds in the past 2 months without intending to.
I work at a nursing home where several residents are being treated for TB.
I quit smoking two weeks ago.

opening.text: I've had a cough for years, and I have long-term bronchitis. It's quite bothersome lately. I've been coughing up blood recently, sweating especially at night, and I've lost 6 pounds in the past 2 months without intending to. I work at a nursing home where several residents are being treated for TB. I also quit smoking two weeks ago.
